hard_failures.label: unregistered second WCC visibility predicate survives in AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH (D1 residue)
hard_failures.detail: AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH's conclusion (lines 402-408) still reads 'every future-inextendible causal geodesic contained in J-(I+) is complete'. J-(I+) is the union of J^-(q) over q in I+ - exactly the set-based reading that class_scope_adjudication D1 demoted: the vacuum class was amended to the single-q TAIL predicate (lines 183-193) and the adjudication says 'F1 carries ONE canonical visibility predicate - the single-q tail predicate - and the set-based form is recorded there as a variant pointer, never as a second predicate' (lines 63-65). The variants block registers variant SET only under AF-WCC-VAC-GEN (lines 79-95), so a second WCC class now carries a visibility predicate that is neither the canonical predicate nor a registered variant, and the two classes share conclusion_type weak_cosmic_censorship with non-equivalent predicates. The file's own text says the two readings 'must never be interchanged'.
hard_failures.falsifier: Show that 'contained in J-(I+)' in the scalar-class conclusion is the single-q tail predicate in disguise, or that the variants block registers the set-based reading under AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH, or that the adjudication scope explicitly excludes the scalar class. Any of these voids this hard failure.

hard_failures.label: AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH uses a bare 'generic' quantifier and asserts an unsourced 'equivalently' (HF-06 pattern repaired in one WCC class only); the D3 record is false for this class
hard_failures.detail: (a) The scalar conclusion begins 'For generic data in the class' while its own H4 says the genericity notion 'is unresolved and must be named before any claim is filed' and axes.genericity_kind is 'unresolved'; field_vocabulary says "'generic' alone is not a machine-readable value" (lines 133-135). (b) The same sentence continues 'equivalently, the singularities that form are hidden behind an event horizon and no singularity is visible from I+', asserting an equivalence with an event-horizon/no-visible-singularity gloss that no hypothesis or source in the class defines - the same HF-06 pattern reviewer 17 removed from AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, whose conclusion now says 'This is a definition, not an asserted equivalence with any other formulation (review HF-06)' (lines 188-193). (c) class_scope_adjudication D3 records 'the comeager quantifier is now stated explicitly in each class conclusion text and bound before the data' (lines 70-72), which is false for this class; the author-side consistency checker cannot detect it because its predicate inspects only the two SCC texts and the legacy C0 phrase (artifacts/formulation/tools/check_taxonomy_consistency.py:59).
hard_failures.falsifier: Point to a named genericity notion (or an explicit unresolved/non-claiming marker) in the scalar conclusion, or to a source that establishes the 'equivalently' equivalence inside the pinned bytes. Either voids this hard failure.
